component.name: DeskAI
component.summary: A dock with focus modes, an inbox and desk restore

description.p: DeskAI is a dock for GNOME 50 that helps you stay on what you're doing, and brings your desk back after a logout.

ul.li: Focus modes, each with its own apps, allowed sites and notification rules
An inbox on the dock for WhatsApp messages and AI agents such as Claude Code
A command bar: press Super+/ and type what you want, in plain words
A status dot for your dev servers and database, with a restart and their log
After a logout, your windows, terminals and dev servers come back as they were

description.p: After installing, open DeskAI Setup and follow the steps.

ul.li: Command bar: press Super+/ and type what you want
The dev servers and database on your desk get a status dot, a restart and their log
A short guide the first time the dock runs
Fixed: the desk wasn't offered back after a reboot, and Chrome came back without its launcher's flags
